scene: A humble cottage in the countryside. The walls are rough stone and the roof is thatched with dry straw. Smoke rises from a small chimney.
caption: [There was once upon a time a woman who lived in a small cottage.]

scene: Inside the cottage. A hearth burns in the corner. A wooden table and two stools sit near the fire. Clay pots line the shelf.
caption: [The cottage was simple, warmed by a single hearth.]

scene: The woman stands by the hearth. She is thin and worn from work. Her apron is patched and her hands are rough.
caption: [She had a son called Minnikin.]

scene: Minnikin stands in the doorway. He is very small for his age, but his shoulders are set and his chin is raised.
caption: He was a brave boy, but very small for his age.

scene: Minnikin stands beside the table. He barely reaches the tabletop. His hands hang at his sides.
caption: [He was small, yet there was courage in his eyes.]

scene: The mother turns from the hearth to face Minnikin. Her expression is serious and concerned.
caption: One day his mother said to him:

scene: Close on the mother's face. Her brow is furrowed. She looks down at her small son with worry.
caption: "Now, Minnikin, you are too little to be of any use."

scene: The mother gestures toward the open door. Beyond it the road winds out into rolling green hills under a wide sky.
action: The mother points toward the door.
caption: "Go out into the world and seek your fortune."

scene: Minnikin looks at the door, then back at his mother. The light from outside falls across his face.
caption: [Minnikin heard his mother's words and knew what he must do.]

scene: Minnikin crosses the cottage floor toward the door. His small footsteps leave no sound on the packed earth.
caption: [He would not stay where he was of no use.]

scene: Minnikin stands at the threshold. One foot is outside on the dirt path. His mother watches from the shadows.
caption: [The world awaited beyond the cottage door.]

scene: Minnikin steps across the threshold. His small figure is framed against the bright daylight outside.
caption: So Minnikin set out.

scene: The road stretches ahead through countryside. Wildflowers line the dirt path. The sky is wide and clear.
caption: [He walked along the road, small against the wide world.]

scene: Minnikin walks past a stone wall. A bird sits on top, watching him pass. His shadow stretches on the ground.
caption: [He had not gone far along the road.]

scene: An old woman appears ahead. She is hunched and wrapped in a dark shawl. Her face is deeply lined.
caption: [An old woman met him on the road.]

scene: The old woman stops before Minnikin. She peers at him with dark, knowing eyes. Her staff is gnarled oak.
caption: [She asked him where he was going.]

scene: Minnikin faces the old woman. He stands straight despite his height. The wind stirs the grass at his feet.
caption: "I am going to seek my fortune," said he.

scene: The old woman smiles. Her wrinkled face creases deeper. She nods slowly.
caption: "Then you may come with me," said the old woman.

scene: The old woman leads Minnikin off the road toward a thicket of trees. Branches arch overhead like a tunnel.
action: The old woman leads Minnikin away from the road.
caption: [She led him to a hidden place among the trees.]

scene: In the clearing, a horse stands tied to a post. Its coat shines like silver. Its mane ripples in a breeze that touches nothing else.
caption: [There stood a horse of extraordinary beauty.]

scene: The old woman places her hand on the horse's neck. The animal does not flinch. It regards Minnikin with calm eyes.
action: The old woman touches the horse.
caption: "I will give you a horse which can go as fast over land."

scene: The old woman turns to Minnikin. Her dark eyes are sharp and certain. The horse's coat catches the light.
caption: "As a ship goes over the sea," said the old woman.

scene: Minnikin looks at the horse, then at the old woman. Amazement shows on his young face.
caption: [Minnikin gazed upon the horse in wonder.]

scene: Minnikin bows his head. The old woman watches him with a satisfied expression.
caption: Minnikin thanked her.

scene: Minnikin approaches the horse. He reaches up to touch its neck. The horse turns its head toward him.
caption: [He stepped toward the horse and reached for the reins.]

scene: Minnikin puts one foot in the stirrup and swings himself onto the horse's back. The horse stands steady beneath him.
caption: And mounted the horse.

scene: Minnikin sits astride the horse. The old woman stands below, looking up at him. The clearing is quiet.
caption: [He sat upon the horse, ready to ride.]

scene: The horse leaps forward. Minnikin grips the reins. The old woman shrinks behind them.
caption: And rode away.

scene: The horse carries Minnikin along the road at great speed. The trees blur past. The wind whips Minnikin's hair.
caption: [The horse flew along the road, faster than any animal Minnikin had known.]

scene: The horse runs across open fields. The ground trembles under its hooves. Minnikin leans into the wind.
action: The horse runs across the fields.
caption: [He rode on for some time.]

scene: A castle appears in the distance. Its towers are tall and white against the blue sky. Banners fly from the highest turret.
caption: [Then he came to a castle.]

scene: The horse carries Minnikin closer to the castle. The walls are high and made of pale stone. Windows glint in the sun.
caption: [The castle rose before him, tall and magnificent.]

scene: The castle gates are open. Two stone lions flank the entrance. The courtyard within is paved with cobblestones.
caption: [The gates stood open, inviting him inside.]

scene: Minnikin rides through the gates into the courtyard. Servants glance up from their work. The horse's hooves ring on stone.
caption: And went in to see the king.

scene: The throne room. Tapestries hang on the walls, depicting battles and hunts. Candles burn in iron sconces.
caption: [The throne room was richly adorned with tapestries and light.]

scene: The king sits on a golden throne. He wears a crown and robes of deep purple. His beard is long and white.
caption: [The king sat upon his throne in the great hall.]

scene: Minnikin stands before the throne. He is small beneath the high ceiling. The king looks down at him.
caption: [Minnikin stood before the king, a small figure on the stone floor.]

scene: The king gestures beside him. On the arm of his throne stands a tiny figure, no larger than a doll. She is exquisitely beautiful.
action: The king gestures toward the princess.
caption: The king had a daughter who was very beautiful.

scene: Close on the princess. She has flowing hair, delicate features, and eyes like jewels. She stands perfectly formed yet impossibly small.
caption: But she was so small that she could sit in the palm of your hand.

scene: The princess turns her tiny head toward Minnikin. A small smile plays on her lips. She is aware of his gaze.
caption: [She regarded Minnikin with curious eyes.]

scene: The king leans forward on his throne. His expression is expectant. He looks from Minnikin to the princess.
caption: "Will you marry my daughter?" said the king to Minnikin.

scene: Minnikin looks at the tiny princess, then at the king. His face is steady and resolute.
caption: "Yes, I will," said Minnikin.

scene: The king nods. He lifts the princess gently and places her in Minnikin's outstretched hands.
action: The king places the princess in Minnikin's hands.
caption: [The king gave his daughter into Minnikin's care.]

scene: The princess sits in Minnikin's cupped palms. She fits perfectly. Her tiny hands rest on his thumbs.
caption: [She sat in his hands as if she were made to be there.]

scene: A wedding ceremony in the castle chapel. Minnikin and the princess stand before a priest. Candles burn on either side.
caption: So they were married.

scene: The priest blesses the couple. The princess stands on a pedestal beside Minnikin so they are the same height.
action: The priest raises his hand in blessing.
caption: [The priest spoke the words of blessing over them.]

scene: Minnikin holds the princess's tiny hand in his. Their eyes meet. The chapel is hushed and golden with candlelight.
caption: [They were bound together by the sacred vow.]

scene: Minnikin rides away from the castle on his horse. The princess rides with him, held safely against his chest.
action: Minnikin rides the horse away from the castle.
caption: Minnikin took the little princess home to his mother.

scene: The horse gallops across the countryside. Green hills roll on either side. The castle shrinks behind them.
action: The horse gallops across the fields.
caption: [They rode together across the open country.]

scene: The cottage appears ahead. The chimney smoke rises into the evening sky. The mother stands at the door.
caption: [The cottage stood at the end of the road, as he had left it.]

scene: Minnikin dismounts and carries the princess to the door. The mother leans close to see the tiny figure.
action: Minnikin carries the princess to his mother.
caption: [He brought the little princess to his mother.]

scene: The mother peers at the princess in Minnikin's hands. She squints and tilts her head. Her brow furrows.
caption: His mother did not know what to think.

scene: The mother straightens up. She looks from the tiny princess to Minnikin and back again. Confusion and doubt fill her face.
caption: For the princess was so small.

scene: Minnikin holds the princess close to his chest. His expression is tender and protective. The princess gazes up at him.
caption: But Minnikin loved her very much.

scene: A distant hill. At its peak, a dark castle sits against gathering clouds. The stone is black and weathered.
caption: [On a high hill there stood a castle of black stone.]

scene: Inside the dark castle, a giant sits on a throne of rough-hewn rock. His limbs are thick as tree trunks. His eyes are small and cruel.
caption: Now there was a giant who lived in a castle on the top of a high hill.

scene: The giant leans forward on his throne. His jaw works as he thinks. Greed flickers in his eyes.
caption: He had heard of the little princess, and he wanted to marry her.

scene: The giant rises from his throne. His shadow falls across the floor like a storm cloud. He towers above his servants.
caption: [He rose from his throne, filled with desire.]

scene: The giant summons a messenger. The servant cowers before the giant's massive form. The giant speaks with a rumbling voice.
caption: So he sent a message to Minnikin's mother.

scene: The messenger carries a scroll sealed with black wax. He hurries down the hill toward the valley below.
action: The messenger runs down the hill.
caption: [The messenger bore the giant's words to the cottage.]

scene: The messenger arrives at the cottage door. He pounds on the wood. The sound echoes through the quiet evening.
action: The messenger pounds on the door.
caption: [A knock sounded at the cottage door.]

scene: The mother opens the door. The messenger thrusts the scroll into her hands. His face is grim.
action: The messenger hands the scroll to the mother.
caption: [She received the scroll with trembling hands.]

scene: The mother breaks the seal and reads the scroll. Her face drains of color. The words are written in dark ink.
caption: "Send me your son's wife, or I will eat you all up."

scene: The mother drops the scroll. Her hands shake. She looks toward the dark hills where the giant's castle stands.
caption: [The threat hung in the air like a dark cloud.]

scene: The mother sits by the hearth. Her face is drawn with fear. The firelight dances on her worried eyes.
caption: The mother was very much afraid, for the giant was very strong.

scene: The mother clasps her hands together. Her knuckles are white. She stares into the flames without seeing them.
caption: [Fear gripped her heart.]

scene: Minnikin enters the cottage. He sees his mother's distress and stops. The door hangs open behind him.
caption: [Minnikin came home and found his mother in distress.]

scene: Minnikin kneels beside his mother. He takes her trembling hands in his own. His eyes are calm.
action: Minnikin kneels and takes his mother's hands.
caption: "Do not be afraid, mother," said Minnikin.

scene: Close on Minnikin's face. His jaw is set. His eyes burn with quiet courage. He is small but unafraid.
caption: "I will go to the giant's castle and fight him."

scene: The mother looks at her son. Tears streak her cheeks. Pride and fear war in her expression.
caption: [She feared for her son, yet she saw his resolve.]

scene: Dawn breaks over the countryside. Minnikin leads his horse from the stable. Mist clings to the ground.
action: Minnikin leads the horse from the stable.
caption: [At first light Minnikin prepared to ride.]

scene: Minnikin mounts the horse. The mother stands at the cottage door, watching. Her silhouette is small against the frame.
caption: So Minnikin rode away on his horse.

scene: The horse gallops away from the cottage. The mother watches until they disappear over the first hill.
caption: [His mother watched until he vanished from sight.]

scene: The horse carries Minnikin across open moorland. Gorse and heather line the path. The sky is heavy with clouds.
action: The horse gallops across the moor.
caption: [He rode toward the giant's castle.]

scene: Storm clouds gather above the hill. Lightning flickers in the distance. The giant's castle is a black silhouette against the sky.
caption: [The sky darkened as he approached the giant's domain.]

scene: The horse climbs the steep hill. The path is rocky and narrow. Thorns claw at Minnikin's legs.
caption: [The path to the castle was steep and treacherous.]

scene: The castle gate looms above. Its iron bars are rusted and twisted. The walls are cracked and covered in dark moss.
caption: [The gate of the giant's castle stood open.]

scene: Minnikin rides through the gate into the courtyard. The ground is stained and uneven. No servant stirs.
caption: When he got there, the giant was not at home.

scene: The courtyard is empty. A well stands in the center, its rope frayed. Ravens perch on the battlements above.
caption: [The castle was silent and deserted.]

scene: Inside the castle hall. A fire burns low in a massive hearth. Shadows crawl across the stone walls.
caption: [The hall was dark, lit only by dying embers.]

scene: A great chair sits by the fire. In it reclines a woman of enormous size. She has three eyes, one in the center of her forehead.
caption: But the giant's wife was there, and she was a great big woman with three eyes.

scene: Close on the giant's wife. Her face is broad and hard. The third eye gleams like a dark jewel above the other two.
caption: [Her three eyes glowed in the firelight.]

scene: The giant's wife turns all three eyes toward the door. Minnikin stands in the entrance, small against the vast hall.
action: The giant's wife turns to look.
caption: [She fixed her gaze upon the intruder.]

scene: The giant's wife rises from her chair. She is immense, towering above Minnikin. Her shadow swallows the floor.
caption: [She rose to her full, terrible height.]

scene: The giant's wife steps toward Minnikin. The floor trembles under her weight. Her three eyes narrow.
caption: "Where is my husband?" said she.

scene: Minnikin does not step back. He stands firm, though the giant's wife blocks the only exit.
caption: [He would not show fear.]

scene: Minnikin smirks. He speaks with a calm, steady voice despite the danger.
caption: "He is out catching men," said Minnikin.

scene: The giant's wife draws herself up. Her three eyes blaze. She points to her third eye.
action: The giant's wife points to her third eye.
caption: "I have one eye more than you," said the giant's wife.

scene: Minnikin glances toward the door. His horse waits outside, restless and ready. He knows he must move quickly.
caption: [He knew the horse was his only chance.]

scene: Minnikin speaks boldly, his chin raised. His small frame seems to grow with defiance.
caption: "But I have a horse that can run faster than your husband," said Minnikin.

scene: The giant's wife roars. Her three eyes bulge with fury. Her mouth opens wide, revealing teeth like jagged stones.
action: The giant's wife roars in rage.
caption: Then the giant's wife was angry.

scene: The giant's wife lunges at Minnikin. Her massive hands reach for him, fingers spread like talons.
action: The giant's wife lunges toward Minnikin.
caption: And she tried to catch Minnikin.

scene: Minnikin ducks under her grasping arms. He turns and runs for the door. His small feet pound the stone floor.
caption: [He dodged beneath her arms and fled.]

scene: The horse stands at the gate, rearing and snorting. Minnikin sprints toward it. The giant's wife crashes through the doorway behind him.
action: Minnikin runs toward the horse; the giant's wife pursues.
caption: [The horse awaited him at the gate.]

scene: Minnikin leaps onto the horse. His foot finds the stirrup. He pulls himself up in one swift motion.
caption: But he jumped on his horse.

scene: The horse bolts forward. Minnikin grips the reins. The wind tears at his clothes. The ground blurs beneath them.
action: The horse gallops away at full speed.
caption: And rode away as fast as he could.

scene: The giant's wife bursts through the castle gate. She runs down the hill on her enormous legs. Her three eyes burn with fury.
action: The giant's wife runs down the hill.
caption: The giant's wife ran after him.

scene: The horse carries Minnikin across the moor. The ground shakes with the giant's wife's footfalls behind them.
action: The horse runs; the giant's wife chases.
caption: [She pursued them across the open moor.]

scene: Minnikin looks back. The giant's wife is huge but slowing. Her long strides eat up the ground but the horse is faster.
action: Minnikin looks back over his shoulder.
caption: But she could not catch him.

scene: The giant's wife stumbles on a rock. She falls to one knee. Her roar of frustration echoes across the hills.
action: The giant's wife stumbles and falls.
caption: [Her fury could not match the horse's speed.]

scene: The horse crests a hill. Minnikin looks back one last time. The giant's wife is a distant figure, growing smaller.
caption: [She fell further and further behind.]

scene: The giant's wife rises and shakes her fist. Her three eyes glare across the distance. But she does not follow further.
action: The giant's wife shakes her fist.
caption: [She could not catch him, and at last she stopped.]

scene: Minnikin rides on. The landscape changes from barren moor to green forest. Birdsong returns to the air.
action: The horse gallops into the forest.
caption: [He rode on, leaving the giant's domain behind.]

scene: A misty forest. Ancient trees with gnarled trunks stand like sentinels. Their branches twist overhead, filtering the light.
caption: [Then Minnikin came to a forest of ancient trees.]

scene: The horse walks slowly through the mist. Moss hangs from the branches. The air is cool and still.
action: The horse walks through the forest.
caption: [Mist clung to the ground like a silver veil.]

scene: A clearing opens in the forest. In its center, a crystal pond reflects the sky. Three ducks swim upon its surface.
caption: [In a clearing there was a pond of clear water.]

scene: The three ducks glide across the pond. Their feathers shimmer with colors beyond nature: gold, blue, and silver.
caption: [Three ducks swam upon the water, radiant and strange.]

scene: The ducks turn their heads toward Minnikin. Their eyes are knowing and sad. They are not ordinary birds.
caption: [They had been princesses, transformed into ducks.]

scene: Minnikin dismounts and approaches the pond. The ducks do not fly away. They watch him with ancient eyes.
caption: [He walked toward the water where the ducks swam.]

scene: Minnikin kneels at the pond's edge. He reaches out his hand. The first duck swims toward him without fear.
action: Minnikin reaches toward the first duck.
caption: [The first duck came to his hand.]

scene: Minnikin lifts the first duck from the water. It rests gently in his palms. Water drips from its shimmering feathers.
action: Minnikin lifts the duck from the pond.
caption: Then Minnikin came to a castle where there were three princesses who had been turned into ducks.

scene: Minnikin holds the first duck and turns to the other two. They swim closer, as if asking to be taken as well.
action: The other two ducks swim closer.
caption: [The other two ducks came to him as well.]

scene: Minnikin cradles all three ducks. They nestle against his chest. The forest seems to brighten around them.
caption: [He gathered all three ducks into his arms.]

scene: Minnikin walks back to the horse with the three ducks. He places them carefully in his saddlebag, where they settle.
action: Minnikin places the ducks in the saddlebag.
caption: [He carried them with gentle care.]

scene: Minnikin rides through the forest toward home. The three ducks peer from the saddlebag, their eyes bright.
action: Minnikin rides; the ducks watch from the bag.
caption: [He took them home to his mother.]

scene: The cottage appears through the trees. The chimney smoke rises. The mother waits at the door as always.
caption: [The cottage stood as he had left it.]

scene: Minnikin dismounts at the door. He lifts the three ducks from the saddlebag. The mother watches with wide eyes.
action: Minnikin lifts the ducks from the bag.
caption: [He brought the three ducks into the cottage.]

scene: Inside the cottage, Minnikin sets the three ducks down on the floor. They stand in a row, feathers glistening.
action: Minnikin places the ducks on the floor.
caption: [He set them down before the hearth.]

scene: A soft golden light envelops the first duck. Its feathers dissolve like mist. A young woman emerges from the light.
action: The first duck transforms into a princess.
caption: [The first duck became human again.]

scene: The first princess stands in the cottage. She is young and beautiful, her hair cascading like water. She blinks in the light.
caption: [She stood as a woman, restored to her true form.]

scene: A second glow surrounds the second duck. The feathers fall away like petals. Another princess appears.
action: The second duck transforms into a princess.
caption: [The second duck became human again.]

scene: The second princess stands beside the first. She is taller, with dark hair and eyes like night. She smiles with relief.
caption: [She too was restored to her human form.]

scene: The third duck glows with the brightest light. All three princesses now stand in the cottage, radiant and alive.
action: The third duck transforms into a princess.
caption: [The third duck became human again.]

scene: The three princesses stand together. They embrace one another. Tears of joy run down their cheeks.
caption: [They were together again, free from the enchantment.]

scene: The mother watches from her chair. Her hand covers her mouth. Amazement fills her face.
caption: [His mother could scarcely believe what she saw.]

scene: Minnikin looks at the three princesses. His gaze settles on the most beautiful. She meets his eyes with a warm smile.
caption: [Minnikin looked upon the most beautiful of the three princesses.]

scene: Minnikin steps toward the most beautiful princess. He takes her hand gently. She does not pull away.
caption: Then Minnikin married the most beautiful of the three princesses.

scene: A wedding feast in the cottage. The table is laden with food. Minnikin and his bride sit at the head. The other two princesses sit beside them.
caption: [A feast was held to celebrate the marriage.]

scene: The mother smiles at the head of the table. Her face is lit with happiness. The fear of the giant has passed.
caption: [The mother's worry was replaced by joy.]

scene: Minnikin and his bride sit side by side. Their hands are intertwined. The firelight dances on their faces.
caption: [They sat together, husband and wife.]

scene: The other two princesses laugh with the mother. The cottage is filled with warmth and the sound of voices.
caption: [The cottage was filled with laughter.]

scene: The feast ends. The five of them sit by the hearth. The fire crackles and pops. The night is quiet outside.
caption: [They sat together by the warm hearth.]

scene: Minnikin and his bride look out the window. The moon hangs over the rolling hills. The countryside is peaceful.
caption: [The world outside was calm and still.]

scene: The distant dark castle on the hill stands empty and silent. No light burns in its windows. The giant never returned.
caption: [The giant's castle stood dark and abandoned on the hill.]

scene: The cottage at dawn. Smoke rises from the chimney. Birds sing in the trees. The sun touches the thatched roof with gold.
caption: [Morning came to the cottage, bright and peaceful.]

scene: Minnikin stands at the door, looking out at the world. His bride stands beside him. The hills stretch green to the horizon.
caption: [They looked out together upon the wide world.]

scene: The mother brings breakfast to the table. All five sit together. The cottage is simple but filled with life.
caption: [They all lived happily ever after.]

scene: The cottage from a distance. Smoke rises into a clear blue sky. The road runs past it, winding toward the horizon. The world is at peace.
caption: [And the story of Minnikin was told for all time.]
